curatedSubtitle: Subscription plans and channel fees are manually maintained and verified regularly
methodologySubtitle: Detailed explanations of how costs, quality tiers, and subscription capacity are estimated

costPerTask.title: 1. Cost Per Task
costPerTask.p1: Every AI task consists of uncached input tokens, cached input tokens, and output tokens. Effective cost per task is calculated using vendor prices per 1M tokens.
costPerTask.p2: Formula: Task Cost = (Uncached Inputs × Input Rate) + (Cached Inputs × Cache Read Rate) + (Cache Writes × Cache Write Rate) + (Output Tokens × Output Rate).
costPerTask.p3: Long-context pricing tiers are applied when input token volume exceeds specified context thresholds. Effective $/1M combines input and output token ratios into a single unit price.

usageProfiles.title: 2. Usage Profiles
usageProfiles.p1: A usage profile defines the token shape of a typical task, daily task volume, and monthly work days.
usageProfiles.p2: Presets reflect common workflows such as Chat/Q&A, Coding Agent, Deep Research, and High-Volume Batch processing.
usageProfiles.p3: Users can customize task shapes, cache hit ratios, work days, and batch execution permissions to match exact requirements.

quality.title: 3. Quality Metrics & Frontiers
quality.p1: Quality scores (0–100) are sourced from Artificial Analysis benchmarks across Intelligence, Coding, and Agentic capabilities.
quality.p2: Quality tiers categorize models by percentile: S Tier (top 5%), A Tier (next 15%), B Tier (next 30%), C Tier (next 30%), and D Tier (remaining).
quality.p3: Manual overrides handle newly launched or unbenchmarked models. The Pareto frontier identifies models providing highest quality at any given cost level.

budgetReach.title: 4. Budget Reach & Top-up Fees
budgetReach.p1: Budget reach calculates how many tasks or days of work a monthly budget buys.
budgetReach.p2: Channel top-up fees (purchase percentage fees and minimum top-ups) are subtracted first to determine net usable API credit.
budgetReach.p3: Work days are estimated by dividing usable task volume by daily task demand.

subscriptions.title: 5. Subscriptions vs API Value
subscriptions.p1: Subscription plans enforce usage limits via rolling windows (e.g., 5-hour windows), monthly quotas, or USD credit allowances.
subscriptions.p2: API-Equivalent Value is computed by evaluating the plan's reference monthly capacity against direct API pricing for the plan's primary model.
subscriptions.p3: Capacity ranges accommodate provider rate-limit variations, weekly caps, and dynamic throttling during peak hours. Confidence badges reflect published clarity.

advisorScoring.title: 6. Advisor Recommendation Logic
advisorScoring.p1: The Advisor ranks setups based on a balanced utility function combining Quality Tier, Cost Efficiency, and Workday Coverage.
advisorScoring.p2: Diversity rules filter out duplicate models across channels, ensuring recommendations include both optimal subscription and API options.

currencyVat.title: 7. Currency & VAT Conversions
currencyVat.p1: Internal computations use USD per 1M tokens. Display values convert currency using ECB reference rates from Frankfurter.
currencyVat.p2: Where official local currency pricing exists (e.g. PLN/EUR subscription prices), it takes precedence over FX conversion.
currencyVat.p3: The VAT toggle applies configured tax rates (e.g., 23% PL VAT) dynamically across displayed prices.

disclaimer.title: 8. Limitations & Financial Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: All metrics and capacity values are estimates for comparative analysis.
disclaimer.p2: Provider prices, subscription terms, and rate limits change frequently without prior notice.
disclaimer.p3: This application does not offer financial or legal advice. Free API tiers may be subject to rate limits and data delays.
